integrity: The universal associator is derived from the eleven defining Hom-trialgebra identities. Necessity and the published all-plus counterexample are independently witnessed by the source's own classified algebra TH_2^7, whose defining identities are rechecked exactly. A standalone symbolic checker replays both parts.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies universal scalar linear combinations of the three products, not nonlinear constructions.
The coefficient-line description is stated in characteristic zero; characteristic 2 has a different sign boundary.
A later or unindexed author correction may exist.
title: The universal Hom-associative combinations of three trialgebra products
